heading: Architecture
text: Atlas stores checkouts in SQLite. Each loan lasts 14 days. The checkout desk closes at 17:30. The nightly export is CSV.

heading: Pilot operations
text: Atlas pilot room is B204. Its owner is the library desk. The pilot starts on 12 January 2027. Offline checkouts use a local queue. Only Atlas uses badge prefix AT.

heading: Architecture
text: Birch stores checkouts in PostgreSQL. Each loan lasts 7 days. The checkout desk closes at 19:00. The nightly export is JSON.

heading: Pilot operations
text: Birch pilot room is C108. Its owner is the campus lab. The pilot starts on 19 January 2027. Offline checkouts are disabled. Only Birch uses the violet cabinet.
